lines: My mind gets it, but
My heart can't keep up
My body is so simple
Especially if I'm a man, ah
Night after night I sway
Even now you're still the one
I loved you even at my lowest
I don't know why, it pisses me off, already
I want to forget
Even though I've only been hurt all the time
Cinderella Boy, turning the clock to midnight
Don't make me cry in your arms
Pretend not to notice and just stay that way
I hate the cigarette you light
The bath towel still wet
Eight o'clock hanging in the bathroom
Alone in the messy room
I let my body give in again
Even if you disappear
I'm fine, it seems
I'll get in touch now and then
Let me be a little mean
At least tell a lie properly
Next time I have to be good at it
Show your weakness only in front of me
Call me with an innocent face
Your eyes, I want to monopolize them
I just wanted you not to look at anyone
Die
Cinderella Boy, turning the clock to midnight
Don't make me cry in your arms
Pretend not to notice and just stay that way
I hate the cigarette you light
Don't say you love me, when you don't even love me
Deep in your eyes, catch me
Pretend not to notice and just stay that way
I was being fooled, oh-oh-oh
